sentences.text: Morgan Stanley advisors have made nearly 50,000 attempts to build AI agents from natural-language prompts, largely to automate routine tasks.
UBS reports its AI software development tools are used by 18,000 of its developers, alongside the STAAT tool for financial advisor teams.
NatWest cut marketing compliance approval times by 80% with AI agents, and its assistant Cora has handled credit card customer issues.
Itaú Unibanco is using AI to migrate its banking systems to the cloud.
Kotak Mahindra Bank says it handles more corporate-servicing volume with the same headcount, and IBK Industrial Bank deployed AI for voice phishing victim relief.
